Product Overview

How about a kettle that keeps your water at the perfect temperature, ready whenever you need it? The Philips 7000 Series Double Walled Kettle (HD9396/90) does just that, with 6 precise settings from 40°C to 100°C. The 1.7L stainless steel inner pot and 2200W of power let you boil enough water for the whole family. And thanks to the double insulated layer, the exterior stays cool to the touch. With convenient features like a 360° base, cord winder, and auto shut-off, this kettle makes your daily cuppa a breeze. Plus, the 2-year warranty gives you peace of mind.

At a glance

This 1.7 L temperature-control kettle suits households, tea drinkers, and anyone who wants more control than a basic boil-only model. Its key strengths are six preset temperatures, double-walled safe-touch design, keep warm function, and fast 2200 W performance. A fair limitation is that it is still a benchtop home kettle, so it is less compact and travel-friendly than smaller basic models.

  • Everyday Boiling
  • Tea Preparation
  • Family Use
  • Variable Temperature Brewing
  • Quick Kitchen Drinks

Things to consider

It offers useful temperature presets and insulation, but it is not as compact or specialised as smaller travel kettles or premium smart kettles with app control and more advanced customisation.

Key benefits

  • 6 temperature settings: Lets you choose from 40°C to 100°C for better results with different drinks and uses.
  • 1.7 L capacity: Boils enough water for multiple cups, making it practical for families or shared use.
  • Double-walled construction: Helps keep the outside cooler to touch for safer everyday handling.
  • Stainless steel inner pot: Provides a durable interior for regular boiling and daily kitchen use.
  • Keep warm function: Maintains your selected water temperature so hot water is ready when you need another cup.
  • 2200 W power: Delivers fast boiling performance for quicker drink preparation.
  • 360° base: Makes it easy to lift, place, and use from any angle.
  • Auto shut-off: Adds convenience by switching the kettle off automatically after boiling.

Q: Does the double-walled design keep the outside cooler than a standard kettle?

A: Yes. The HD9396/90 uses a double-walled build that heats the stainless steel interior while helping the outer body stay cooler to touch than a single-wall kettle. The outside can still warm up, so it should not be treated as heatproof.

Q: Is the inside of the Philips HD9396/90 stainless steel rather than plastic?

A: Yes. Philips specifies a 1.7L stainless steel inner pot, which is useful if you want less plastic in contact with hot water. Philips does not describe the whole kettle as completely plastic-free, so that claim should not be assumed for every part.

Q: Can this kettle show the water temperature while it is heating?

A: Yes. The display on the handle lets you choose from 6 temperature settings and shows the water temperature as it heats. That is useful for tea, coffee and other drinks where boiling to 100C every time is not ideal.

Q: Is the Philips 7000 Series kettle suitable for baby bottles or lower-temperature drinks?

A: Yes. Its 40C to 100C temperature range gives more control than a boil-only kettle for warming water for some drinks and baby-feeding routines. It is not a steriliser, and infant formula should be prepared using current health guidance and brand directions.

Q: Does the Philips HD9396/90 have a keep-warm function?

A: Yes. This model is listed with a keep-warm function, so it can maintain hot water after reaching the selected setting for repeat use. The provided specs do not state the exact hold time, which matters if you want long bench-top standby between cups.

Q: How many cups of water can the 1.7L capacity make?

A: The 1.7L capacity is roughly enough for 6 to 7 standard 250mL mugs, or fewer if larger mugs are used. That makes it a practical size for family use and helps reduce repeat boils when several hot drinks are made together.
